title: [review] project-LICHEN-6mij.2.4: _Nonnull annotations on coap_oscore_auth_result fields are incorrect
description:
P1 correctness — `struct coap_oscore_auth_result` at `coap_oscore.h:124-130` declares `struct oscore_ctx *_Nonnull ctx` and `const uint8_t *_Nonnull payload`, but:

1. `ctx` is explicitly set to NULL at `coap_oscore.c:301` for the local-admin (non-OSCORE) path
2. `payload` is not set at all when `coap_packet_get_payload` returns NULL (line 297-300, only sets when non-NULL)

A `_Nonnull` pointer that is actually NULL violates the contract and can cause static analyzer false negatives. On Clang with `-Wnullability`, this may produce warnings.

**Fix:**
- Change `ctx` to `_Nullable` (it IS legitimately NULL for local admin)
- Change `payload` to `_Nullable` (it CAN be NULL for empty payloads)
OR ensure both are always non-NULL on success (initialize `payload` to empty/sentinel).
The callers already check `auth.payload == NULL` appropriately.

**Affected:**
- `lichen/subsys/lichen/oscore/include/lichen/coap_oscore.h:125`
- `lichen/subsys/lichen/oscore/include/lichen/coap_oscore.h:126`
- `lichen/subsys/lichen/oscore/coap_oscore.c:301` (ctx = NULL)
- `lichen/subsys/lichen/oscore/coap_oscore.c:297-300` (payload left unset if coap_packet_get_payload returns NULL)
